wire-format.why: fetch sends URLSearchParams(FormData) as urlencoded body with post[title], post[body], post[tags][] names intact, matching .serialize(), and the summary states this.

empty-tags.why: FormData omits unchecked checkboxes just like .serialize(), so no tags param is sent when none are checked; the summary also says output 'should be the same' (though unverified).

dirty-class.why: The form gets className 'dirty' from React state and the comment and summary explain this keeps leave-guard.js's form.dirty check working.

debounce.why: DEBOUNCE_MS = 1000 with clearTimeout on each edit, and the effect cleanup calls window.clearTimeout(timer) on unmount.

status-text.why: Status is set to 'Saved' with dirty cleared on success and 'Not saved' on failure without clearing dirty, matching the original.

no-silent-changes.why: PATCH and X-Requested-With are preserved and called out, and the summary flags the unmount cleanup, 4xx/5xx handling, the esbuild choice, and that nothing was built or run.
